question: If the perimeters of two similar triangles ABC and DEF are 75 cm and 40 cm respectively, and if overline{BC} is 15 cm, then the length of overline{EF} is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **similar triangles**, the ratio of their perimeters is equal to the ratio of their **corresponding sides**.

Ratio of Perimeters = Ratio of Sides

75 ÷ 40 = 15 ÷ EF

⇒ EF = (15 × 40) ÷ 75

⇒ EF = 600 ÷ 75 = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Perimeter of ▵ABC = 75 cm

Perimeter of ▵DEF = 40 cm

Length of side BC = 15 cm

**Formula Used:**

If ▵ABC ∼ ▵DEF, then:

Perimeter of ▵ABC ÷ Perimeter of ▵DEF = AB ÷ DE = BC ÷ EF = AC ÷ DF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/013fad8f1e93ee36e80a29679f53c39d50e3458c992bbdd3c7199edb7f5efef3.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Perimeter(▵ABC) ÷ Perimeter(▵DEF) = BC ÷ EF

⇒ 75 ÷ 40 = 15 ÷ EF

⇒ EF = (15 × 40) ÷ 75

⇒ EF = 600 ÷ 75

⇒ EF = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Similar Triangles

The ratio of the **areas** of two similar triangles is equal to the square of the ratio of their **corresponding sides** or perimeters: Area₁/Area₂ = (Side₁/Side₂)².

Similarity Criteria

Two triangles are similar if they satisfy the **AAA** (Angle-Angle-Angle), **SSS** (Side-Side-Side ratio), or **SAS** (Side-Angle-Side ratio) criteria.

Linear Ratios

The ratio of any linear components (**medians, altitudes, angle bisectors, or circumradii**) of two similar triangles is equal to the ratio of their **corresponding sides**.</p
